材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章先提出梦可能帮助记忆与学习，再用章鱼睡眠行为展示观察的吸引力与局限。结尾提醒我们从动物自身的感官世界理解梦，并把跨物种研究作为理解人类梦境的一条可能路径。

原文第5段

Nevertheless, in many cases REM sleep does seem to have benefits. Growing evidence from birds and mammals suggests that REM sleep and dreaming are important for forming memories and learning. It is believed that when events are replayed in dreams, this helps to integrate memories into longer-term storage. As soon as animals evolved moderately complex lifestyles, they would have needed to dream in order to manage these lifestyles.

鸟类和哺乳动物的证据逐渐支持快速眼动与梦对记忆、学习有重要作用。一种解释认为，梦中重现事件有助于把记忆整合到较长期储存中。关于复杂生活方式促使动物需要梦的说法仍带有推断性；it is believed和would have needed都不是对进化过程的直接录像式描述。

原文第6段

However, we still don't understand how this outward behaviour relates to internal experience. It seems impossible to know what it is like to be a rat or a pigeon, let alone imagine their dreamscapes. We are quick to interpret the twitching limbs and quiet barks of sleeping dogs, but the truth is that we don't know if there is an internal experience of chasing rabbits that comes along with that.

However明确区分外在行为与内在体验：我们容易把睡着的狗抽动和轻吠想象成追逐兔子，但其实不知道它是否真的有这种梦境。人甚至难以知道作为老鼠或鸽子的体验是什么样，更不用说具体的梦世界。这段不是否认动物会做梦，而是限制人类解释行为时可以声称知道多少。

原文第7段

Another non-human dreamer offers insight here. In 2019, while making a documentary, David Scheel of Alaska Pacific University in the USA housed an octopus named Heidi in a tank in his living room. At one point, in the middle of the night, Heidi seemed to dream: her limbs and head moved, and her skin rapidly changed colour, as though she was pursuing a crab.

作者引入2019年章鱼Heidi的观察。它睡眠时肢体、头部活动，皮肤迅速变色，看起来像在追螃蟹。seemed和as though表明这是依据行为作出的类比，而不是已确认章鱼确实梦到了某只螃蟹。

原文第8段

Similarly, a report recently emerged of a sleeping octopus apparently having a nightmare. Costello, as the octopus was called, thrashed around, extended his mantle as if trying to make himself look bigger, and squirted ink as though he were being attacked by a predator. The nightmare study is intriguing, says Scheel, but is only based on one animal. He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

另一只章鱼Costello出现剧烈扭动、伸展外套膜和喷墨，看起来像应对捕食者，因此被描述为可能做噩梦。Scheel认为这很有趣，却指出观察只涉及一只动物，还需要脑成像来支持梦中重演清醒活动的解释。本段将令人印象深刻的个例，与形成更稳固认识所需的证据区分。

原文第9段

The trouble is that we will never be able to experience any animal's dreams. That goes for other humans' dreams too. But we can try to imagine what these dreamscapes are like by meeting animals on their own terms. For example, vision is the dominant sense for many humans, and so our dreams are heavily visual too. Dogs primarily navigate the world using smell while spiders rely much more on vibrations.

作者承认，人无法直接进入其他动物甚至其他人的梦，但可以从物种自己的感官特点出发想象其体验。人类多依赖视觉，狗依赖嗅觉，蜘蛛较依赖振动，因此不能把所有动物的梦都想成一段人类式视觉电影。on their own terms要求尊重不同物种的生活方式。

原文第10段

It is likely that dreaming has served multiple purposes since the first complex animals evolved. And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

结尾提出，梦自复杂动物演化以来可能承担了多种功能；如果如此，更好地理解这些功能也许能帮助理解人类的梦。likely、if、possible和might层层保留条件，作者以开放的研究方向收尾，而没有给出唯一且最终的梦的用途。

词语与搭配

forming memories and learning

形成记忆与学习

两个动名词并列，说明研究讨论的功能；本段说证据逐渐支持相关作用，并未给出适用于所有物种的统一机制。

integrate memories into longer-term storage

把记忆整合进较长期的储存

integrate...into...表示并入某个系统或结构，longer-term是相对较长期，并非永不遗忘。

as well as outward behaviour

除了外在行为以外

as well as在此补充另一类所需证据，后面提出脑成像；不是说行为观察毫无价值。

on their own terms

从它们自身的条件和生活方式出发

their指动物，强调不要只套用人类的感官经验；此处不是交易或谈判中的条款。

shed light on

帮助解释、增进对……的理解

这是照亮的比喻，常用于研究贡献；比prove更克制，不表示一次研究已经解决全部问题。

句子精读

He argues that as well as outward behaviour, brain imaging is needed to show that the octopuses are replaying sequences of activities from their waking lives in dreams.

他认为，除了外在行为，还需要脑成像来显示章鱼是否在梦中重演清醒生活中的一连串活动。

He指Scheel；argues that标明这是他的研究判断。主句内容是brain imaging is needed，as well as...补充已有的行为证据。to show说明成像的目的，后面的that从句是待支持的解释；from their waking lives修饰activities，与in dreams形成清醒经历和梦中重演的关系。原文并不是说成像证据已经取得。

And if this is the case, it is possible that better understanding of these purposes might shed light on the true purpose of our own dreams.

如果情况确实如此，那么更好地理解这些功能，或许能帮助我们理解自身梦境的真正用途。

this is the case回指上一句梦可能自复杂动物出现以来承担多种功能。it是形式主语，that从句给出真正内容；better understanding是该从句主语，these purposes指梦的多种功能。if、possible、might共同保留条件和不确定性，不能把整句改述为研究已经确定人类做梦的目的。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

shed light on

帮助增进理解

常见搭配是research/findings may shed light on a process or question。适合讨论基础研究的潜在贡献，同时保留may、could等程度词，不把研究方向写成已经证实的成果。

用于写作：科研由政府还是企业控制的题目涉及研究激励；该表达可用于说明公共资金支持无即时商业回报的基础研究这一理由。它是写作中的政策论点，不是原文对资助模式作出的结论。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。
Mapungubwe｜贸易、器物与衰落未作答段落信息匹配 / 多项选择 / 摘要填空 · 4 段 · 430 词 · 10 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 44 页

Q14/15/17：段落信息匹配A–G。Q20–21：Choose TWO letters A–E，顺序不限。Q22–26：Complete the summary. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage.

DThe Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River. The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea. Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala. It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.

EArchaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society. Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps. There are also ceramic discs, and whistles. In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found. The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known. Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.

FBeautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe. A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it. These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold. One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads. These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150. They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.

GThe kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts. Trade routes may also have shifted northwards. Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.

20–21. The archaeological record reveals information about gold and the kingdom of Mapungubwe. Which TWO pieces of information are mentioned by the writer?

  • A Not everyone in Mapungubwe used gold as a form of payment.
  • B Items of gold were placed close to where Mapungubwe kings were buried.
  • C The most valuable item discovered in Mapungubwe was a sceptre made of gold.
  • D The way gold was decorated in Mapungubwe was also practised in another kingdom.
  • E Working with gold was a respected occupation in the Mapungubwe community.

22. The Mapungubwe community's 22 __________ is indicated by the amount of professionally made pottery discovered at the site.

23. Other finds include round ceramic objects, 23 __________ and figures of various animals

24. as well as models of people with stretched 24 __________.

25. It is possible that these had a role in ceremonies to honour 25 __________.

26. In addition, pieces of 26 __________ made from a local metal have been found at the site.

对照答案，回到证据

第 14 题 · E

不确定性是precise function is not known，对象为figures；不是所有出土器物用途均不明。

The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known.

第 15 题 · G

droughts是气候因素，进一步加剧过度人口带来的资源压力。

a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts

第 17 题 · D

merchants是带货商人，by sea对应by ship。

merchants travelling from India by sea

第 20–21 题 · B；D

B对应王室墓地；D由“found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe”支持。C把“可能是权杖”升级为“最有价值”，原文没有；E无职业声望信息。

These objects were all found at the royal burial site

第 22 题 · prosperity

专业制陶规模是社会繁荣的指标；题干amount与large enough呼应。

another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society

第 23 题 · whistles

ceramic discs已由round ceramic objects改写，下一并列项是whistles。

There are also ceramic discs, and whistles.

第 24 题 · bodies

stretched对应elongated，而limbs被描述为short，应答bodies。

humans with elongated bodies and short limbs

第 25 题 · ancestors

to honour对应as offerings to，保留祖先的复数。

used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors

第 26 题 · jewellery / jewelry

local metal具体为copper，题干问金属制成的物品而非金属名；原答案接受英美拼写。

small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper

材料精读 · 内容与词句

器物与贸易遗存让作者推测Mapungubwe的跨区域联系、工艺生产和政治权力；金器还显示珍贵材料不只有货币用途。结尾从繁荣转到衰落，并把人口、资源、旱灾和贸易变化作为可能相互作用的因素，而非单一确定原因。

D

D The Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River. The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea. Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala. It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.

动物遗骸和象牙碎片使作者推测皮毛、象牙可能沿林波波河与沿海地区交易；玻璃珠则提示通过沿海商人与印度相连的贸易网络。当地铜以及经过该区域的黄金贸易也带来利益。最后进一步推测，为控制甚至垄断有利可图的区域联系，政治权力可能得到强化。器物发现、贸易路径与政治解释之间是逐层推论，并非所有细节都同样确定。

E

E Archaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society. Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps. There are also ceramic discs, and whistles. In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found. The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known. Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.

大量陶器提示专业陶工可能存在，也被作者用来说明社会繁荣。器物包括容器、杯、碗、陶盘、哨子和动物或人物小像，其中一些有装饰。这些小像可能用于祭祖，但具体用途尚不清楚；当地铜制首饰则补充了手工业种类。形态可以较直接描述，用途仍需保留不确定性。

F

F Beautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe. A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it. These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold. One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads. These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150. They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.

金器工艺包括把金制成小片、刻上几何图样，再用金钉覆盖木制物品；木质部分没有保存下来。可能的权杖、锤打金片制成的犀牛和大量金珠都来自约1150年的王室墓地。作者将这些解释为当地黄金除了交换货币用途，也具有自身珍贵意义的早期已知线索。first known限定的是目前所知证据，并非断言此前绝不可能存在。

G

G The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts. Trade routes may also have shifted northwards. Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.

到13世纪末，王国已走向衰落。作者推测人口过多使资源承压，一系列干旱可能进一步把情况推向危机，贸易路线也可能北移。相比这些可能原因，北方大津巴布韦等地区后来兴盛是文中更明确陈述的趋势。段落保留多种因素共同作用的空间，没有给出唯一被证实的衰落原因。

词语与搭配

in turn

继而、转而

这里连接贸易链的下一环：沿海国家又与从印度来的商人交易，不是说每件物品都由Mapungubwe直接运到印度。

on a scale large enough to suggest

规模大到足以使人推测

large enough to...说明达到某种程度，suggest保留由数量到专业分工的推断性。

their precise function is not known

它们的确切用途尚不清楚

function指器物用途，their回指小像；已知外形不等于已知使用方式。

an intrinsic value of its own

自身具有的内在价值

这里与货币交换价值相对照，描述黄金作为珍贵物品本身的意义。

placed too much stress on local resources

给当地资源施加了过大压力

place stress on后接承压对象，local resources可以包括维持人口和生产所需的资源；本段用probably保留因果判断的限度。

句子精读

The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea.

玻璃珠的出现——这些珠子几乎可以确定来自印度——表明当地曾与沿海其他国家进行某种贸易，而这些沿海国家又与乘船从印度来的商人交易。

主干围绕The presence of glass beads说明其提示的贸易联系。almost certainly from India插入说明珠子的可能来源，of some sort保留对贸易具体形式的未知。who指沿海国家所代表的交易方，in turn引出下一环；travelling...修饰merchants。原文使用indicate，本句引用保留原样，阅读时核心名词presence按常规主谓一致应搭配indicates。

The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts.

到13世纪末，Mapungubwe王国已在衰落，可能因为人口过多给当地资源带来过大压力，而一系列干旱又可能使这种局面达到危机程度。

主干是The kingdom...was already in decline，by限定到某个时间为止的状态。probably because引入可能原因，a situation概括资源受压的局面，that从句进一步说明旱灾可能如何加剧它。may have been brought是对过去事件的可能性判断，不是确认旱灾是唯一原因。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

placed too much stress on local resources

给当地资源带来过大压力

可根据句子时态改为place或places，保留place stress on的搭配。谈旅游时应具体说明水、土地或公共设施等资源，不能把古代王国衰落直接当作现代旅游的实证。

用于写作：题目讨论旅游对当地环境与居民的代价；资源压力能够具体解释游客增长可能产生的成本。

Artificial Intelligence｜公共部门实施条件未作答选择题 / 选词摘要填空 · 3 段 · 223 词 · 5 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

Q29：Choose A–D. Q30–33：Complete the summary using words A–I. 原选项完整保留。

原文第4段We are now seeing governments pledge support to national AI initiatives and compete in a technological race to dominate the burgeoning machine-learning sector. While many politicians proclaim the transformative effects of the coming 'AI revolution', they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world.

原文第5段One of the most promising varieties of AI technologies are neural networks. This form of machine learning is loosely modelled on the neuronal structure of the human brain, but on a much smaller scale. But what many politicians do not understand is that simply adding a neural network to a problem will not automatically mean that you'll find a solution. Similarly, adding a neural network to a system of government does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair.

原文第6段AI systems need a lot of data to function, but the public sector typically does not have the appropriate data infrastructure to support advanced machine learning. Most of the data remains stored in offline archives. The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy. More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed. Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.

共用选项 · 原题 30、31、32、33

  • A reliability
  • B funding
  • C skills
  • D prejudices
  • E computers
  • F equality
  • G framework
  • H confidentiality
  • I approval

29. In the fourth paragraph, the writer suggests that many politicians may

  • A have failed to appreciate the true potential of AI initiatives.
  • B have misunderstood the function of the machine-learning sector.
  • C be unaware of the challenges of implementing national AI initiatives.
  • D be too keen to enter the race to dominate the machine-learning sector.

30. Neural networks are a promising area of AI technology for governments. However, many politicians overestimate their capabilities, believing that the mere addition of a neural network will produce solutions and promote 30 __________.

31. Most public sector organisations have not set up the necessary 31 __________ to manage the huge amount of data required to enable AI to function.

32. Complex bureaucracy is another issue, as each person involved needs 32 __________ to access the relevant data, which is often spread across different departments.

33. But the main problem is that few public sector employees have the 33 __________ to take full advantage of machine intelligence.

对照答案，回到证据

第 29 题 · C

unaware of challenges对应fail to realise complexity；国家竞争只是背景。

they fail to realise the complexity around deploying advanced machine learning systems in the real world

第 30 题 · F

inclusive or fair概括为equality；注意摘要描述政治家过度期待，不是作者认可。

does not mean it will be instantaneously more inclusive or fair

第 31 题 · G

data infrastructure对应管理数据的framework，不只是computers。

does not have the appropriate data infrastructure

第 32 题 · I

permissions对应approval；confidentiality是保密性，不是取得访问权。

each require special permissions to be accessed

第 33 题 · C

capabilities概括为skills；Above all对应摘要main problem。

lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

这三段把AI的宏大承诺拉回公共部门的实施条件。先写政治热情与实际复杂性的落差，再解释神经网络不自动带来结果，最后列出数据、组织流程与人才等条件。它讨论的是技术部署的能力边界，不是说所有政府永远不能使用AI。

原文第4段
